appraisal_events.evidence: « j'admirais que, pour cette jeune fille dont j'avais cru autrefois ne pouvoir jamais faire la connaissance, rentrer chaque jour chez elle, ce fût précisément rentrer chez moi »; « [le plaisir] remplissait ma demeure, jadis vide, d'une permanente provision de douceur domestique, presque familiale »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator dwells admiringly on Albertine's now-secure, integral place in his home and daily life, framing her presence as a source of stable domestic happiness rather than diminishment, consistent with the consummation-and-renewal reading of attained intimacy.

status_effects.explanation: Albertine's presence is locally elevated as the settled, admired center of the narrator's domestic and emotional life, distinct from the surrounding surveillance and jealousy material.
